title: Farmers抉择粮食作物
reason: The video describes changes in wheat production and consumption due to economic pressures and government initiatives.

tasks.task: Describe the current situation of wheat production in Yemen.

subtasks.text: Observe the use of homegrown wheat, which is more nutritious but more expensive than imported cereals.
Note the trend of Yemen importing over 80 percent of its wheat and the scarcity of local wheat.
Highlight the decline in the use of domestic wheat due to lower costs of foreign wheat.

tasks.task: Explain government efforts to reduce Yemen's dependence on imported wheat.

subtasks.text: Watch the government's action to make the price of domestic wheat the same as imported wheat.
Notice the government's investment in land planting and irrigation to increase wheat production.
Describe the expected increase in wheat production to cover domestic needs.

tasks.task: Discuss the influence of ghat on agricultural practices in Yemen.

subtasks.text: Observe the production of ghat, which is a lucrative business for many farmers.
Note the higher profitability of ghat compared to other crops.
Highlight the demand for ghat among the population.
Describe the dilemma of prioritizing food crops over ghat.
Watch the government's effort to combine ghat production with other crops.
Notice the goal of using some of the agricultural water supplies currently used for ghat.
